description: This file defines the AWS MachineLearningClient class, which extends AwsClient. It provides methods to interact with AWS Machine Learning services, including creating, deleting, and describing ML models, data sources, and evaluations. The class also customizes request handling to redirect the Predict command to a specified endpoint.

classes.name: MachineLearningClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS Machine Learning service, allowing API interactions such as creating and managing models, data sources, predictions, and evaluations. It extends AwsClient and adds custom endpoint handling for the Predict operation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the client with configuration options and appends a custom handler for the Predict endpoint.

methods.name: predictEndpoint
methods.description: Private method returning a callable that modifies the request URI for the 'Predict' command to use a specified endpoint.
